question: Explain the concept of Big O notation and give examples.
intendedUser: Professional in Track-A with early-career experience
description: Technical interview question for Track-A professionals.
exampleAnswer: Big O describes time/space complexity. O(1) constant (array access), O(n) linear (loop), O(n²) quadratic (nested loops), O(log n) logarithmic (binary search). In my project, I replaced a nested-loop search (O(n²)) with a hash map lookup (O(1)), reducing processing time from 30s to 0.5s for 10,000 records.
